# fall-euaiact

> fall-euaiact is a sovereign, MIT-licensed tool in the AI-Native Solutions estate. Listed on FallMarket. Ed25519-signed. Runs on your infrastructure.

## Canonical URL

https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fall-euaiact/

## What it is

A sovereign tool that ships as source, runs offline, and outlasts the vendor. Part of a 1330+ listing catalog under @ai-native-solutions/*.

## Owner and steward

- Organization: AI-Native Solutions
- Website: https://ai-nativesolutions.com

## The estate compliance kernel
- comply.mjs + law/law.json: every estate build ships a compliance map (EU AI Act role and risk tier, GDPR / UK GDPR / AI Act duties on its stack, each quoted from the primary text and dated), generated from its compliance.decl.json by tools/comply-build.mjs and checked by konomify on every build.
- AI Act dates after the Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744): Article 5 from 2 February 2025; Article 50 from 2 August 2026 (Article 50(2) marking for systems already on the market: by 2 December 2026); Annex III high-risk from 2 December 2027; Annex I from 2 August 2028.
